title: Earlier bands: Bolden, Black Benny, and staying out of the bars
summary: Russell asks about Keppard, Bunk Johnson and Bob Lyons; Robinson recalls Bolden and Black Benny and says he avoided drinking.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the other bands when you were younger? Did you ever hear Freddie Keppard? No. That you remember?
Or Bunk Johnson? No, I never did hear him. He played with the Superior Band or Frankie Doosen.

Who used to play a lot up here at the Eagle, by the Eagle Saloon, you know, where they... Yeah. On Rampart. And near Perdido Street. Perdido Street. Bob Lyons used to stay around there too. Do you remember Bob Lyons, the bass player?
Well, which of the boys that played blow themselves out once?
That might be Bolden, I guess. Buddy Bolden probably.
I think it was Buddy Bolden, I think he was 12.
I think that's before you moved to the city, I think he must have...
Yeah, another fella used to beat a drum, I believe. His name was... Black Benny.
I never got to know him, no.
He died before I moved down here. Yeah.
He used to play with them boys down there, the Sonic.
Yeah, that same corner down there, that was his hangout too.

I never did wonder much, you know. I'd always stay home and like I'm doing now. Never did fall for just to stay out there drinking, you know. Some of them would drink, drink until they fall out, you see. But I never let liquor...
